question.text: What is the penalty range for insider trading under Section 15G of the SEBI Act?

answer.text: Minimum ten lakh rupees, maximum twenty-five crore rupees or three times the profits made, whichever is higher
Minimum one lakh rupees, maximum one crore rupees
Minimum five lakh rupees, maximum ten crore rupees
Minimum twenty-five lakh rupees, maximum fifty crore rupees

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 15G prescribes a penalty not less than ten lakh rupees, extendable to twenty-five crore rupees or three times the amount of profits made out of insider trading, whichever is higher. The Trap: The lower one-lakh-minimum range applies to less severe violations such as information filing failures under Section 15A, not to insider trading. Note: The statutory maximum may extend to the higher of Rs. 25 crore or three times insider-trading profits; this is the ceiling of the range and not the penalty necessarily imposed in every case.
